key_insight: For cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, suitably chosen large learning rates enable SGD to achieve an accelerated O(T⁻²) convergence rate despite stochastic gradient noise.
engineering_relevance: The results motivate exploring larger learning rates in supported model settings rather than relying solely on classical curvature-based stability limits.
method: Characterize stochastic optimization trajectories under large learning rates.
Establish accelerated convergence for cross-entropy with linear predictors and two-layer networks.
Derive tighter stable-regime guarantees, including improvements for deterministic gradient descent.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments demonstrating practical benefits from large learning rates, but gives no datasets, configurations, or quantitative comparisons.
watch_item: The guarantees concern specific losses and model classes with suitably chosen stepsizes; they do not imply arbitrary large learning rates are safe for general deep networks.
paper_title: SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates
